pages.title: The Forgotten Hands
pages.text: Ancient scholars knew that proximity was the key to control—but what of scale? As civilizations grew, they needed Mythos-powered tools to function even when no hand guided them. Enter the Mythos Pylon, a relic from the lost age of automation and ritual magic.

pages.title: Shaped Recipe
pages.text: Pylons serve as conduits of intent, allowing Mythos Items to operate as though held by a living soul. When placed atop a Pylon, an item continues to draw, channel, and interact with Mythos as if wielded—extending a user’s will through stone and time.
